document.title: Daytime and Nighttime Kids' Multi-Symptom Cold & Flu Combo pack

manufacturedProduct.name: Daytime and Nighttime Kids Multi-Symptom Cold and Flu combo pack

partProduct.name: Kids Multi Symptom Cold and Flu
Kids Nighttime Multi Symptom Cold and Flu

list.item: temporarily reduces fever and relieves these common cold/flu symptoms:
minor aches and pains
headache
cough due to minor throat and bronchial irritation
sore throat
runny nose
sneezing
controls the impulse to cough to help your child get to sleep

text.paragraph: Liver warning: This product contains acetaminophen. Severe liver damage may occur if your child takes

list.item: more than 5 doses in 24 hours, which is the maximum daily amount
with other drugs containing acetaminophen

text.paragraph: Allergy alert: acetaminophen may cause severe skin reactions. Symptoms may include:

list.item: skin reddening
blisters
rash

text.paragraph: If a skin reaction occurs, stop use and seek medical help right away.
Sore throat warning: if sore throat is severe, persists for more than 2 days, is accompanied or followed by fever, headache, rash, nausea, or vomiting, consult a doctor promptly.

list.item: with any other drug containing acetaminophen (prescription or nonprescription). If you are not sure whether a drug contains acetaminophen, ask a doctor or pharmacist.
with any other product containing diphenhydramine, even one used on skin

paragraph.content: Ask a doctor before use if the child has

list.item: liver disease
glaucoma
cough that occurs with too much phlegm (mucus)
a breathing problem such as chronic bronchitis
persistent or chronic cough such as occurs with asthma or if cough is accompanied by excessive phlegm (mucus).

paragraph.content: Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if the child is

list.item: taking the blood thinning drug warfarin
taking sedatives or tranquilizers
do not use more than directed
marked drowsiness may occur
sedatives and tranquilizers may increase the drowsiness effect
excitability may occur, especially in children

paragraph.content: Stop use and ask a doctor if

list.item: pain or cough gets worse or lasts more than 5 days
fever gets worse or lasts more than 3 days
new symptoms occur
redness or swelling is present
cough comes back or occurs with rash or headache that lasts

text.paragraph: These could be signs of a serious condition.

code.displayName: OTC - KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN SECTION

paragraph.content: Keep out of reach of children.

text.paragraph: Overdose warning: In case of overdose, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away (1-800-222-1222). Prompt medical attention is critical even if you do not notice any signs or symptoms.

item.content: this product does not contain directions or complete warnings for adult use
do not give more than directed (see Overdose warning)

list.item: for accurate dosing, use measuring cup provided. Do not use with any other dosing device.
children 6 to under 12 years of age: 10 mL in dosing cup provided every 4 hours while symptoms last, do not give more than 5 times in 24 hours
children under 6 years of age: do not use unless directed by a doctor
store between 20-25°C (68-77°F)
do not refrigerate

text.paragraph: agave syrup (organic), blueberry flavor (organic), flavors (natural), purified water
